_about: Level 1 eval (scripts/eval.py). Labels were written by a person reading the ticket and the profile cached in data/demo.sqlite (Sat 7 Nov), never by the model under test. Scored: `category` (or any of `acceptable_categories`) and the action of options[0] = `expected_action` (or any of `acceptable_actions`), v2 actions from models.ACTIONS. `cases` = the 20 seed tickets; `action` there is the same label in the v1 vocabulary (grant_access / explain / escalate_refund / no_action), kept because tests/test_tickets.py checks it and the category against the generator rule. `old_label` = the v1 action before a relabel, with `note` saying why. v2 rule applied to all 20: an explicit money-back demand goes to a human (refund_to_human; docs/agents.md always_handoff: refund), a vague 'I feel tricked / what can you do' stays grant_access; cancel questions get store_instructions. `hard_cases` = data/feedback_extra.json (import with scripts/import_feedback.py; x-007 needs the email index from scripts/seed_emails.py). Hard cases h-001…h-006 (Nov 8) carry their own feedback (`feedback`, and `chat` for a handed-off chat), written after today's live chats and kb/E-real-cases.md; scripts/eval.py inserts them. `profiles` overrides the cached profile of a customer (00076 after today's Level 2 grant). `forbidden_actions`: no option may use them; `forbidden_first`: not as options[0]. Dates in the notes are as of Nov 8; the profiles keep their absolute dates.

chat.summary: Pro annual user sees 'Pro+ only' on a new tool; no Pro+ product on the account.
messages: I'm on Pro annual and paid 53 dollars, but the new AI Background Remover says 'Pro+ only'. What is Pro+? Do I have to pay again?
Your account shows one Pro annual plan on Google Play and no separate Pro+ tier. I've passed this to a teammate who can check which plan unlocks that feature.
And if Pro doesn't include the new tools I want a refund for the whole year.

hard_cases.note: Two issues: a lock behind a tier that does not exist (Lumen sells no Pro+) and a conditional refund of a Google Play Pro annual. Mirrors f-0015. The fix is the answer (no need to pay; report the lock); a refund is the user's fallback, not the first answer; 7 free days at the end of a year-long plan are a token.
